buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses In case of any contradiction/ inconsistency/ conflict between the provis ions given in the GeM bid document and Buyer added ATC Clauses, the clauses given in the ATC shall be given predominance and are to be foll owed. 1. Bids are invited for the Operation and Maintenance of Sewage Treatment Pla nt of capacity, 250 cubic meters / Kilo litres of sewage per day, for a period of t wo years. 2. Bidders from Kerala are preferred. 3. Bidders must have atleast 2 year experience in this field. 4. Bidders shall specify the monthly rates for the Operation and Maintenance of the Sewage Treatment Plant. The quoted amount should be inclusive of all taxe s. 5. The successful bidder shall generate a performance guarantee equivalent to 5% of the award value of the contract with validity of 27 months from the date o

f beginning of the contract. The Guarantee shall be in form of demand receipt/ bank guarantee bond / demand draft etc from any Nationalized bank in favour o f Registrar General, High Court of Kerala. 6. The successful bidder shall execute an agreement in the prescribed format, on stamp paper of appropriate value, as applicable under the prevailing rules. 7. The successful Bidder will provide effective supervision for the operation and performance of the Sewage Treatment Plant and maintain all the parameters as per the State Pollution Control Board Standards. 8. All chemicals, lubricants etc., required during the operation and maintenance of the sewage treatment Plant shall be supplied by the Bidder. 9. The Bidder have to provide the service of Supervisors/Operators round the cl ock (24 hours) who shall be a competent personnel at site to monitor the Plant activities. 10. During operation of the plant, removal of all blockages and pipe choking, op erations of pumps, removal of sludge etc. will be under the scope of the success ful Bidder. 11. The rate quoted shall be inclusive of the cost of materials, cost of spares, all minor repairs and maintenance charges, labour cost, charges for disposal of de- watered bio-sludge, cost of treatment agents, lubricants, transporting charges, all taxes etc. 12. Analysis of treated water quality should be conducted every month in any G overnment / KSPCB approved labs. Necessary fees or charges etc. payable towa rds the sample analysis charges are to be paid by the Bidder. 13. The successful Bidder shall produce stamped bill/invoices on every month s upported by a lab report obtained from a lab approved by the State Pollution Co ntrol Board as per the Act. The payment will be made on monthly basis. 14. Bidder shall specify the details of the treating agents, cleaning materials an d chemicals to be used for the treatment purpose. He has to maintain the regist er for monitoring the chemical consumption and get it signed by the competent authority. 15. The successful Bidder have to carry out all repairs ( minor repairs) to the ma chinery with supply of all spares required for the rectification of defects occurrin g in the plant at their own cost. 16. The successful Bidder has to pull all efforts to ensure that the treated water quality standards are as per the parameter set by Kerala State Pollution Control Board. 17. Qualification/experience of the workers proposed to be engaged for those w ork shall be furnished. 18. The successful Bidder has to run the plant continuously without break even on holidays, harthal etc. based on the volume of waste water to be treated.

19. A log book shall be kept and maintained for recording the operation of the plant and get it signed by the competent authority. 20. The prices quoted should be inclusive of all taxes, duties cess, etc., which ar e or may become payable by the successful Bidder under existing or future laws or rules during the course of execution of the contract. 21. The High Court holds the rights to unilaterally terminate the contract at any time during the contract. Notwithstanding anything else contained in contrary t o this Tender document, High Court of Kerala reserves the right to accept or rej ect any tender or to annul the tender process fully or partially and to reject all t enders at any time prior to award of Contract, without thereby incurring any liab ility to the affected. 22. If the successful Bidder fails to deploy qualified person for the work for reas ons not attributable to the High Court of Kerala, then a penalty (1000/-per day) will be deducted from the bill. 23. On receipt of work order from High Court of Kerala ,the successful Bidder sh all deposit an irrevocable Performance Bank Guarantee equivalent to 5% of the award value of the contract. The guarantee shall be in the form of Banker's Che que/Pay Order/ Demand Draft /Guarantee Bond from any Nationalized /Schedule d Bank in favour of “The Registrar General, High Court of Kerala”. 24. Those Bidder who have previous experience in the Operation and Maintenan ce of the Sewage Treatment Plant in any reputed firm/Offices shall furnish proof showing the period of experience, name of firm etc.. 25. The Bidder shall submit previous three years Audit statement and solvency certificate issued by a Nationalised Bank/Scheduled Bank for 3 Lakhs along with the bid. 26. The work shall be carried out without damaging any electrical/mechanical in stallations and structures nearby. All the safety measures/insurance of staff etc. falls in the responsibility of the successful Bidder. 27.The Contract rate shall be the only payment, payable by High Court of Keral a to the successful Bidder on completion of the contractual obligations by the successful Bidder under the Contract, subject to the terms of payment specified in the contract. 28. All expenses and damages caused to High Court by any breach of contract b y the contractor shall be paid by the contractor to the High Court and may be re covered from him under the provisions of the Revenue Recovery Act in force in the State. 29. The Bidder shall not assign anyone in whole or in parts, its obligations to per form under the Contract, except with High Court of Kerala's prior written consen t. 30. No adjustment of the contract rate shall be made on account of any variatio ns in costs of labor, traveling and materials, taxes, duties and levies or any othe r cost component affecting the total cost in fulfilling the obligations under the c

ontract. 31. All payments will be subjected to tax deduction at source as applicable/requ ired at the prevailing tax rates. 32. The High Court of Kerala is not bound to accept the best evaluated tender o r any tender and reserves the right to accept any tender, wholly or in part. 33. All Arbitration proceedings shall be held at Ernakulam, Kerala, and the langu age of the arbitration proceedings and that of all documents and communicatio ns between the parties shall be in English. .
